page.layout: One page: a three-line heading at the top; below it a central oval engraved portrait with inscription ring and cartouche; below that four lines of Latin verse in italic.

main_text.l: IN IMAGINEM V. C. D. PETRI
PETRVS MARTYR VERMILIVS FLORENTINVS ANNO AETATIS SVAE LXIII

l.i: Hunc genuit Florentia, nunc peregrinus oberrat,
Quo stabilis fiat civis apud superos.
Illius effigies haec, mentem scripta reconduns:

page.notes: Engraved oval portrait of Peter Martyr Vermigli, bust in three-quarter view, wearing a flat cap and a fur-trimmed gown; the oval has a double ring with the inscription running round it, and a cartouche at the bottom holding the death date. Ring text is printed in capitals, and its reading order runs clockwise from the top. Cartouche date is printed with reversed-C numerals (CIↃ IↃ), transcribed as MDLXII; the printer's "PRI" is kept as printed. Doubtful readings: "oberrat" and "reconduns" in the verse are read from a slightly blurred scan. A brown water stain covers the top left corner; it is not text and is left out.
